items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: His brother, Henry Boca Eyes, Pete's brother Henry was playing bass.

ctx.x: You don't even mess with the baritone. You play more baritone, he's a baritone. Please play more. Louis Cotter Notice all that syncopation of brass playing? Notice it? You know there's plenty of syncopation in those days, you know, the rhythms. Oh what was that valve trombone player's name? Henry Turner. Did he have a nickname? We used to call him Nick. He used to play bass tubal and valve trombone. Let's see. True Blue Lou, who arranged that, did I ask you? Billy Douglas. Billy Douglas. And Sheik of R.B. was…

I was a member of a group of brass bands. So you become a member then? You don't get elected a member. No, it's just a guy who used to join his band and you join him. And when you cut out you just tell him, well I think I'm going with so and so. It's not a contract, it's just a word. That's all it is. What was the first brass band you ever worked? I think the Excelsior Brass Band was the first brass band I worked. It was in Jordan McCullum's place he sent me. He was a regular member of the brass band. And if I'm…
I was just wondering what a drilling group did. I haven't heard about them.

items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: There was a little clarinet player Lorenzo Teo. A gentleman called Dugas, Ray Dugas. And... Walter Dugas, Piano player. And myself. And we had a couple of Bocais with us. Henry and Charlie Bocais. And we were all working out at the... At the lake.

ctx.x: Was Pico still playing High Society then? Before he played all his days. That's a great song. Yeah.

And I had a chance to meet Louis. Well, I... How it really came about... I was working at a place called the Parish Royal. It's one of those... Swimming camps out on the lake. Mm-hmm. There was a little clarinet player Lorenzo Teo. A gentleman called Dugas, Ray Dugas. And... Walter Dugas, Piano player. And myself. And we had a couple of Bocais with us. Henry and Charlie Bocais. And we were all working out at the... At the lake. At this place, the Parish Royal. Somewhere out there where... Close to where the…
And I met him. You went from the lakefront over to the suburban?
